description: Update the display details shown for a deleted account in the Net Worth views. Applies to all historical entries for that deleted source. At least one field must be provided; pass null to clear a field.

account_id.description: The deleted_account_id from a balance history entry whose source type is `deleted`.

display_name.description: Display name for the deleted account.

institution_name.description: Name of the institution that held the deleted account.

mask.description: Last few digits of the deleted account's number.

name.description: Official or full name of the deleted account.

name: update_deleted_account_details
